name: nexus
description: NEXUS memory for Claude: retrieval from a store on this computer, and a sealed record of what the model was shown and what it said. Learning is frozen in this bundle.
long_description:
NEXUS keeps a store on this computer and makes no network calls. Before answering, Claude calls `nexus_retrieve` for the context NEXUS would inject; after answering, `nexus_record` seals what it was shown and what it said. `nexus_recall` and `nexus_asof` read the record back.

**Learning is frozen in this bundle.** Nothing NEXUS observes changes what it retrieves later. This is fixed by the bundle and is not a setting; `nexus_status` reports it on every call, and every record carries it.

**The owner** you enter is recorded on every record as the accountable identity: asserted by you, never verified.

**The data folder** holds the store and its logs. Left empty, it is a per-user application-data folder: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NEXUS` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support/NEXUS` on macOS. One NEXUS process opens a store at a time; a second is refused by name.

tools.name: nexus_retrieve
tools.description: Call before answering: the context block NEXUS would inject for the question, and a retrieval id for nexus_record.

tools.name: nexus_record
tools.description: Call after answering: seals the record of what you were shown and what you said.

tools.name: nexus_recall
tools.description: Every sealed answer that rested on a claim, oldest first (read-only).

tools.name: nexus_asof
tools.description: What the store held at an instant with a UTC offset (read-only).

tools.name: nexus_assert
tools.description: Shows exactly what a statement would store; stores nothing.

tools.name: nexus_assert_confirm
tools.description: Stores a statement as the user's own belief, only when confirmed is true.

tools.name: nexus_commit
tools.description: Commits to a note you supply, salted and sealed, without disclosing it; only when confirmed is true.

tools.name: nexus_record_action
tools.description: Records an action you report for a turn, as client_reported: NEXUS did not see it happen.

tools.name: nexus_status
tools.description: Learning mode, owner, coverage counters and open retrievals.

owner.title: Owner (your name or e-mail)
owner.description: Recorded on every record as the accountable identity: asserted by you, never verified.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where NEXUS keeps its store and logs. Leave it empty for the per-user application-data folder (Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\NEXUS; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/NEXUS). Not a synced folder: a store must be open on one computer at a time.
